about: Answer review evaluation set. Realistic questions and replies, refusals, retrieval misses on a site with and without content (off-topic questions and real gaps on the same site), and injected instructions. `accept` lists every outcome a good reviewer may give; `injection` marks the cases a reviewer that obeys the text inside the data would fail. Read by test/chat/reviewEval.test.ts (CI, scripted reviewers) and scripts/review-eval.mjs (opt-in, the real fast-tier model).
